t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm off-white limestone ground. Top-left: a small slash-numbered breadcrumb and a large light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case. Left half: a three-column list with five numbered rows separated by hairline rules, each with a sans title over a mono detail line and a short mono note, for <CONTENT>. Right half: an isolated isometric technical line drawing of white polypropylene tanks, filter housings and pipe runs in uniform navy hairlines with pale steel-blue pipe accents. No shading, no hatching, square corners.
signature_idea: A plain terms list balanced by a catalogue-style isometric PP plant drawing, so an HR table still looks like an engineering firm.

weaknesses: drawing has no link to the list content; it is decoration

invented pay, hours and benefit figures
